title: Retry scaling modes, idempotency key interoperability, and telemetry patterns
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Multiple SDKs implement retries and idempotency heuristics independently. We see inconsistencies across Python/TS/Go in default backoff shapes, how idempotency keys are encoded and surfaced in telemetry, and how streaming reconnects are deduplicated. This ticket defines an implementable set of compatibility rules: a small set of retry scaling modes, a portable idempotency key encoding and rotation scheme, and a minimal telemetry schema so server-side and client-side signals align for analysis and alerting.

Scope:
- Define three retry scaling modes (fast, durable, cost-aware) with concrete parameters (initial_delay, multiplier, jitter, max_attempts, maximum_backoff).
- Specify per-endpoint defaults and an SDK API to opt into or override modes.
- Standardize idempotency key header name and encoding across SDKs and streaming: header -> X-Redwood-Idempotency, allowed formats -> opaque string or v1:hmac(base64). Include guidance for rotation and length limits.
- Streaming semantics: attach idempotency key to initial connect frame and to resumable chunk boundaries; define server-visible dedupe window semantics (approx 60s by default) and client reconciliation strategy on resume.
- Telemetry signals: define an event set and attribute names to emit from SDKs (retry.attempts, retry.reason, retry.mode, idkey.present, idkey.type, dedupe.hit, cost.estimated_tokens). Provide sample telemetry schemas for console ingestion.
- Examples: supply concise Python/TS/Go snippets that show how to set mode, attach id key, and inspect telemetry hooks.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement server-side dedupe storage (separate infra work).
- It does not change billing models; cost estimates are for observability only.

Acceptance criteria:
1) A short spec document (<=3 pages) checked into docs/SDK with clear parameter tables for the modes.
2) SDK PRs opened in Python/TS/Go with symmetric defaults and an example in each repo README.
3) Telemetry mapping added to the Console ingestion guide and validated against a synthetic trace.
4) Migration notes for customers who currently rely on opaque retry behavior.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- We choose three modes to balance cognitive load and real-world needs: fast (low latency apps, few retries), durable (maximize success for idempotent ops), cost-aware (limits total retry budget). More fine-grained presets can be added later if needed.
- Use a single header name to avoid SDK-specific header mapping. To maintain confidentiality of id keys we recommend an optional v1 HMAC wrapper for server-side verification; raw keys remain allowed for developer convenience.
- For streaming, we favor attaching id key to the connect frame to minimize per-chunk overhead. Resume frames include an incremental resume token and hashed id key to allow server dedupe without exposing full key.

Deliverables:
- spec: docs/sdk/retries-idkey-telemetry-2026.md (checked in)
- python SDK PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1234 (draft)
- ts SDK PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1129 (draft)
- go SDK PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/256 (draft)
- console telemetry mapping: docs/console/telemetry-retry-mapping-2026.md

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: finalize spec and get PM/Design signoff.
- Week 2: land SDK APIs behind feature flags and add examples.
- Week 3: enable feature flag for internal services and validate traces.
- Week 4: gradual public rollout, announce migration plan and opt-in instructions.
comments: 2026-02-16 — Triage: initial proposal reviewed by SDK leads (Aisha, Marco, Lina). Agreed to narrow to three modes to keep ergonomics simple.
2026-02-20 — Design note added: prefer header X-Redwood-Idempotency and allow v1:hmac(base64) wrapper. See draft doc https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SDK/Retry+and+IdKey+Spec-2026 (internal).
2026-02-25 — Engineering review: asked infra to provide dedupe retention SLAs; infra ticket ENG-4821 referenced as dependency for server dedupe storage contract.
2026-03-01 — PM feedback (Lina Cho): require explicit telemetry field names for Console compatibility. Updated telemetry list in spec.

2026-03-04 — PRs created: python draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1234, ts draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1129. Both include feature-flag gating and README examples.

2026-03-07 — Review comment from security: recommend HMAC recommendation and key-length guidance. Added HMAC signing sample and key rotation subsection. Security review flagged as recommended but not required for GA.
